column1: #This file contains basic configuration for the Salem and Albany rules to show which reservoirs support the rule and the min/max conservation pools for those reservoirs

#The SummerBufferElev parameter is based on judgement, and represents when to abandon the Salem/Albany operation because we are drafting too deeply. This replaced the old "buffer" zone, and is assumed to apply linearly in time from SummerBufferElev on 31July to MinConElev on 31Oct.

#The MaxRelease parameter is based on judgement, and is a limit on the release each project can contribute to mainstem flow targets. If left unchecked, projects might draft extremely fast to meet mainstem flow targets.
